title: GEOF Source
description: A data source declaration. The same material may serve several roles (engine input, observation, evaluation); each role must be declared. An aggregate-only source supports aggregate observations and must not be used to fabricate instance-level events.

access.description: How the material was obtained: API, log export, crawl, panel run, chain read, report download, ...

coverage.description: What part of the population this source can see

license.description: License or terms under which the material is used

visibilityScope.description: What the source holder can and cannot see (black-box engine, aggregate report, ...)

timeMapping.description: How the source's reported times map to the registry clock, when they differ

identity.description: Operator or system identity of the source
